answer:
Verdict: cannot tell from this trace

## CPU use and what it shows

Across the trace (offsets **0–30,589.6 ms**), **calc-3 (TID 636899, in crunch PID 636881)** ran for **3,052.2 ms**, including **3,050.9 ms in user mode**. But it spent more time waiting to be scheduled (**19,211.6 ms, 62.8%**) than running.

Calc-3 did **not** stand out among its peers: calc-0 through calc-4 each used about **3.04–3.06 seconds of CPU** over the trace. So the measurements don’t identify one thread as unusually CPU-hungry. They also can’t establish whether the CPU work accomplished anything useful; the trace doesn’t show the program’s computation or intent.
